title: Compiled requirement introspection
summary: A compiled template can report unique variable paths and formatter names in first-use order. TemplateRequirements returns detached copies without resolving context data, invoking object getters or running formatter code; dev3 also reports which formatter names are not present in the captured registry.
uses: preflight whether required data is available
inspect report/message/prompt requirements before domain formatter authorities are supplied
inspect missing formatter bindings and explicitly create a rebound template
invariants: Requirement inspection is observation, not execution.
Unformatted substitutions explicitly require the identity formatter.
Requirement arrays returned to callers are detached copies.
An unavailable domain formatter does not prevent parsing or requirement inspection.
